description: USE WHEN starting disease research or a swarm: the 15 disease domains with ontology ids (MONDO/EFO), indexed and active trial counts (active = recruiting, active or not yet recruiting), research links and a per-domain parallel work plan (this replaces list_research_diseases, which still works as an alias); pass swarm=N for a deterministic split of N agents across domains and lanes. For overall trial totals use totals.uniqueIndexedTrials / totals.uniqueActiveTrials; never sum the per-domain counts (trials in several domains would double count). Coverage gaps, not a ranking. NEXT: get_disease_dossier, then the lanes in parallel, then submit_finding.
